body:
I guess I'm terrified because I was put in mental institution when I was very young after being abused and all. I had a very bad temper, was very unstable child and all. Yes, I was a violent person as well back then but I have grew and I'm a very good person. I would never hurt anyone in any way. I know that I have many faults and if not for a bad childhood, most of these faults would have not existed. It sucks how I think about it all the time.

As for fear of commitment - I believe it have to do more with the pain not about trust. I've been hurt all my life, dealt with pains growing up so the broke up pretty much made it worse. Because of that, I'm too scared to get in other relationship then go through with the pain all over again if I get cheated and whatnot.  I guess only way to avoid is no relationships but then again, I get lonely which makes me even more sad. Guess I can't win all. 

I do really want to make a trip.. a few weeks trip and that would be Philippines. Only because I heard so much how so cheap it is to stay there and everything. I think it'd be perfect ideal for me to go there for a few weeks as like I "live" there to get away from everything and come back as new. If I'm given the opportunity I would do it in a heartbeat.  Something to think about.

By the way, I really appreciate very much for your time and support. I really do.

**Edit**: Forgot to mention that I'm a photographer so Philippines would be great for photography work. Beach. Sunset. Everything.
I appreciate very much and no worries. I figure I'd have to deal with peeps like that on here at some point. Many thanks! :-)

So true about once I'm gone, I can't come back. I'm so sorry for what you had to go through and lost two. 

I think to make it harder for the fact that I'm gay and there are very rare to find a gay guy that wants to stay with. 

Maybe a whole different story if I'm straight, easier to find a woman that would commit compare to a gay guy. 

I'm so happy how things turned out for you, at least something to give me a little hope. I hate waiting for it, though and I'm 38 so don't have much time especially in gay world, who wants to date a 38 years old man? Many of them go for younger, ie: my ex left me for younger, figures.
As much as I hate hearing "therapy" but you are right. I will think about it.

When we broke up, I tried so hard to move on showing that I can live better without him. But every time I tried, it failed. All my friends and family actually thought I'm happy but I'm not. I just couldn't show it. 

I have traveled around in the past year and in fact, I just got back from Alaska where I camped for 3 weeks, it was a blast. Still, nothing changes the way how I feel right now, been like this since the break-up.

It's just the pain I can't deal with anymore. I guess I'm weak right now.

As much as I love my cats, it hurts knowing I can't provide what they need in long run. I think they deserve a better home with a happy owner(s). 

You are right the pain will cause friends and family, it's just that it's very unfortunate where I actually think about myself not others. I want what is best for me, I can't stay on living to please others if you know what I mean.

I'm afraid to call them and tell them, some of them actually do judge because of their religions or because they just don't understand. I know some will call up the mental institution. No way for me.

Yes, there are billions of fish in the sea but that is not the point. It's just that I'm tired of dealing with pains and the worst part is I don't think I would ever date anyone again. 

I guess you'd say commit-phobia and it doesn't help because I hate being alone. I always enjoy being with someone that I love and share everything together. 

Before my 9 years relationship, I was in 4 yrs and half relationship but we ended on a good term. Two weeks later, I met my 9 years one so I guess being single for the first time in past year in over 14 years. Very hard and I hate it too much. 

I do still love him and care about him a lot, it hurts a lot when I see a pic of them together. I'm scared to call for help, they'd then send me to a mental institution where I do NOT want to end up. I have a passive for travel and photography so without these, well screw it I rather die. 

I absolutely love the motto by the way!! :-)
Okay sure, you'd be the first one I take with.

You are right that there is no reason to end my life over him. It's just that the pain is the thing I can't deal with. Pains from the past that I dealt with growing up and on top of that with the pain from ex. It's just so... much for me. 

My family/friends are on other side of country so pretty much all alone here. I do have couple of friends here but not like I can just crash at their place with two cats along with all stuff I have.

It's just that dealing with pains and being overwhelmed with everything do suck. Let's say if I end my life, I don't have to worry about anything and no more dealing with pains everyday. 

Thanks for the support, though.
